messages:
emma: FYI customer (oliver) reporting surge in retries + duplicate billing after pip upgrading to redwood-python 1.48. They say requests are retried twice in <10s window.

oliver: Repro summary — we upgraded from 1.47 -> 1.48 yesterday. Simple usage:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=..., model='rwd-enc-1')
resp = client.generate(prompt='hi')
```
We see repeated POSTs and two token charges for the same user call. Logs show connection resets and immediate retry.

mike: Can you paste a short log snippet + the exact pip freeze and whether you're using the default transport (httpx) or requests? Also need request ids if available.

oliver: pip freeze: redwood-sdk==1.48.0, httpx==0.24.0. Transport: default. Log (abridged):
```
2025-08-03T14:03:12Z INFO request_id=req_01GxXx ConnectionResetError during send -> retrying
2025-08-03T14:03:12Z INFO request_id=req_01GxXx retry=1 POST /v1/generate
2025-08-03T14:03:12Z INFO request_id=req_01GxXx response 200 tokens=46
2025-08-03T14:03:12Z INFO request_id=req_01GxXx retry=2 POST /v1/generate
2025-08-03T14:03:12Z INFO request_id=req_01GxXx response 200 tokens=46
```
We also have server request ids: srv_9aBc, srv_9aBd — two different server ids for the same client request.

emma: That looks like the client retried but server treated it as a new request (no idempotency header). Do you pass an idempotency key in your call?

oliver: No, we rely on the SDK to add the idempotency key. We didn't set anything explicit. Same code worked fine on 1.47.

sage-bot: FYI SDK changelog 1.48: removed automatic keepalive header + renamed idempotency kwarg from `idempotency_key` -> `idemp_key` (doc update). Also changed default retry policy to aggressive immediate retries on connection errors. Link: https://changelog.redwood/1.48 (internal).

arjun: If the SDK renamed the kwarg and silently dropped the old param in some call paths, that could explain missing Idempotency-Key header. Combined with a more aggressive retry backoff, transient connection resets would trigger multiple non-idempotent requests.

mike: Agreed — root cause hypothesis: 1.48 introduced param rename + kept old alias removal. When using higher-level convenience methods (generate/chat) the idempotency header isn't injected if users rely on the old kwarg or implicit behavior. We'll reproduce locally.

emma: Short-term mitigation: ask affected customers to pin redwood-sdk==1.47.0 and set environment REDWOOD_RETRY_STRATEGY=conservative if possible. Can we provide a one-line pip command?

mike: pip install 'redwood-sdk==1.47.0' — that will restore previous behavior. For customers who can't pin, a workaround: explicitly set an Idempotency-Key on your requests:
```py
resp = client.generate(prompt='x', idemp_key='acct-oliver-20250803-1')
```
This prevents duplicate billing for retries.

oliver: Confirmed pinning to 1.47 fixed our dev env. Thanks. Happy to help with traces.

sage-bot: Filed SDK ticket: SDK-2891 "restore idempotency alias + conservative retry default". ETA: hotfix release 1.48.1 in 24-48h.

arjun: Ops note — please collect the server request ids (srv_9aBc/srv_9aBd) and open a billing ticket to refund duplicate tokens. I'll loop infra for trace retrieval.

emma: Action items: (1) Support ask customer to pin to 1.47 + set explicit idemp_key if possible, (2) Mike/sdks to validate and cut 1.48.1, (3) Finance to review refund for srv_9aBc/srv_9aBd. I'll update the customer. :thumbsup:
